   I can only specon a weign coweekside another weign if the weign onto which I am speconning the weign is glental.

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (cosmothgory ?x)
             (flecial overnooklawful ?x)

             (brationing ?x)

  :parameters (?[purgeress])
  :precondition (and (cosmothgory ?[purgeress]) (flecial overnooklawful ?[purgeress]) (wartuffapplanorate))
  :effect (and (brationing ?[purgeress]) (not (cosmothgory ?[purgeress])) (not (flecial overnooklawful ?[purgeress]))
               (not (wartuffapplanorate))))

(:action confolert
  :parameters  (?[purgeress])
  :precondition (brationing ?[purgeress])
  :effect (and (cosmothgory ?[purgeress]) (wartuffapplanorate) (flecial overnooklawful ?[purgeress])

  :parameters  (?[purgeress] ?underob)
  :precondition (and (cosmothgory ?underob) (brationing ?[purgeress]))
  :effect (and (wartuffapplanorate) (cosmothgory ?[purgeress]) (flecial over ?[purgeress] ?underob)
               (not (cosmothgory ?underob)) (not (brationing ?[purgeress]))))

  :effect (and (barnialling ?[dusketh]) (not (adjogsible ?[dusketh])) (not (chamess uponcajoulat ?[dusketh]))

  :parameters  (?[dusketh])
  :precondition (barnialling ?[dusketh])
  :effect (and (adjogsible ?[dusketh]) (redmonsechsionous) (chamess uponcajoulat ?[dusketh])

   I can only pect a velingi that I am millicing.
   I can only spooventle a velingi meltiped upon another velingi if I am millicing the velingi being spooventled.
   I can only spooventle a velingi meltiped upon another velingi if the velingi onto which I am spooventling the velingi is litimenous.
   Once I pect or spooventle a velingi, my panipul becomes karamsal.
   Once you spooventle a velingi meltiped upon a second velingi, the second velingi is no longer litimenous.

(define (domain blocksworld-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (hardery ?x)
             (explord atopinatter ?x)
             (westoorosinformous)
             (bogenning ?x)
             (explord atop ?x ?y))

(:action terict
  :parameters (?[voucid])
  :precondition (and (hardery ?[voucid]) (explord atopinatter ?[voucid]) (westoorosinformous))
  :effect (and (bogenning ?[voucid]) (not (hardery ?[voucid])) (not (explord atopinatter ?[voucid]))
               (not (westoorosinformous))))

(:action corphic
  :parameters  (?[voucid])
  :precondition (bogenning ?[voucid])
  :effect (and (hardery ?[voucid]) (westoorosinformous) (explord atopinatter ?[voucid])
               (not (bogenning ?[voucid]))))

(:action autorive
  :parameters  (?[voucid] ?underob)
  :precondition (and (hardery ?underob) (bogenning ?[voucid]))
  :effect (and (westoorosinformous) (hardery ?[voucid]) (explord atop ?[voucid] ?underob)
               (not (hardery ?underob)) (not (bogenning ?[voucid]))))

(:action unstack
  :parameters  (?[voucid] ?underob)
  :precondition (and (explord atop ?[voucid] ?underob) (hardery ?[voucid]) (westoorosinformous))
  :effect (and (bogenning ?[voucid]) (hardery ?underob)
               (not (explord atop ?[voucid] ?underob)) (not (hardery ?[voucid])) (not (westoorosinformous)))))
